deadline.value: Apply by January 10, 2027 (the page heading still says Fall 2026, but the date is in this cycle); late applications are considered only if places remain.

funding.value: All PhD students have five years of support with satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: All students in the PhD program have five-year support, provided satisfactory progress is made towards the degree.

entry_route.value: A master's is not needed; calculus, matrix algebra, probability and programming are expected.
entry_route.quote: A Master’s degree is not a prerequisite for the PhD.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required for fall admission.

fee_waiver.value: No fee waiver for international applicants, but the department refunds the fee if you are admitted and accept.
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waivers are not available for international students. However, the Department will reimburse the application fee to those who receive our admission and accept our offer.

notes: Fall entry only. About 10-20 admitted a year from 400-600 applications.
